column1: # Query → the method it should find, against a discourse checkout.
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every label is a judgement
# about what a person would mean; a wrong one makes the eval lie in the
# flattering direction. Veto or amend any line — the harness reads this file.
# Method behaviour was verified by reading the source, not recalled. Queries
# deliberately avoid naming the method: a query containing its own answer
# measures string matching, which is what baseline:name isolates.
# discourse is the app-shaped corpus: services, jobs, plugins, migrations —
# where rails is a library with dictionary-word method names. Same bands as
# the rails set so the two reports read side by side.
# Run with:  cd <discourse checkout> && contour eval <this dir>
# --- easy on purpose: queries that share tokens with the answer's name -------
# baseline:name should do well here; the contrast with the sections below is
# the point.
silence a user who keeps breaking the rules
grant a badge to a user
cook raw post markdown into html
anonymize a user account
move posts to a different topic
hash a password with its salt
full text search across topics and posts
# --- no token shared with the answer's identifier: the thesis case -----------
turn a title into a url friendly form
throttle how often someone may repeat an action
the link to a discussion thread
remove accounts that never finished signing up
the periodic activity summary sent by mail
decide whether a visitor may view a discussion
wipe a member and everything they ever wrote
accept an invitation and create the account it promised
should this address be refused at signup
queue work to happen in the background
run something after the current web request is done
how many edits turn one string into another
the number of alerts a member has not yet seen
# --- behaviour that appears in NO identifier ---------------------------------
# Retry, backoff, memoization, cross-process consistency: the body knows; no
# name in the corpus says so.
compute a value once and reuse it until it expires
retry a failed download after waiting a moment
wait longer and longer between attempts to grab a lock
make sure only one process runs a block at a time
keep a cached value consistent across all app servers
